top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of the inspection the primary caregiver s First Aid and CPR certification was expired.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.801(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two cats and two dogs do not have up to date vaccinations.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver had seven students in care ages 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, and 22 months old. The operation was out of ratio by one student.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1303(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The assistant caregiver's orientation checklist was not available to review during the inspection time.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the four children records reviewed were missing health statements.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All booster seats in both transports were expired since 2015-2017.
